description: C99 port of the IoT-J trust scorers (V1, submitted V2, revised V2'): JS equivalence, latency, footprint, operation counts. See c-scorer/README.md.

host.msvc: Microsoft(R) C/C++ Optimizing Compiler Version 19.44.35222 for x64

android: no device attached during the run

equivalence.method: export-inputs.mjs writes dev/val/test (10,000 traces each) with the JS signals and trustScores of 10 configurations; ts_driver verify compares bit for bit.

latency.method: dev split, full context (fixes + network), 2 warm-up passes, 30 timed passes, per-score latency = time of 32 consecutive calls / 32; median and p99 over chunks. x86 also times single calls with lfence+rdtsc (10 ns TSC granularity on Zen 2) minus the empty-pair overhead.

x86_64-msvc.label: Microsoft(R) C/C++ Optimizing Compiler Version 19.44.35222 for x64 /O2 /fp:precise, UCRT libm; pinned to one core, high priority

x86_64-gcc.label: w64devkit gcc -O2 -ffp-contract=off, mingw-w64 libm (x87 fpatan for atan2); pinned, high priority

node-v8.label: paper-scorer.mjs / revised-scorer.mjs in Node, high priority (JS also parses ISO timestamps)

footprint.note: object = scorer only (code incl. Xtensa literals; rodata = constants); linkedClosure = scorer + newlib libm + libgcc soft-float helpers pulled in by a --gc-sections link of V2 and V2' (mcu_entry.c), bytes

O2.stackNote: Win64 ABI frames include the 32-byte shadow space and callee-saved XMM spills

operationCounts.method: TS_COUNT_OPS build; per-block annotations count double operations as compiled (x/2 and x/0.5 as multiplications, x/1 folded); libm calls counted at the call. Mean [min-max] per score over dev+val+test.

mcuEstimate.label: ESTIMATE, not a measurement: mean operation counts x published per-operation cycle costs of software double precision on a Cortex-M0. Cores with a 32x32->64 multiplier (Cortex-M4, Xtensa LX6, RV32IMC) should be faster; a double-precision FPU (Cortex-M7 FPv5-D16) far faster.

gccSoftDoubleCortexM0.source: Qfplib-M0-full README, "GCC library" column (Cortex-M0, LPC11U68, avg cycles incl. call overhead)
